opportunities.title: Propose vulnerability identity key and lifecycle schema
opportunities.summary: ### Summary Inspect the committed Anchore JSON fixtures and propose a schema for tracking vulnerabilities over time. Specifically: what combination of fields uniquely identifies "the same vulnerability" across scans? Candidates to evaluate include CVE ID alone, CVE + package name, CVE + package name + version, and CVE + package + image. Write up the tradeoffs, pick a recommendation, and sketch the analytics DB table(s) needed to support first_seen / last_seen / fixed_at / ignored_at / cleared_at fields. **Tech notes:** The Anchore JSON schema is documented at the Anchore project site; worth skimming before diving into fixtures. The goal of this spike is a decision, not code — resist the urge to start implementing. ### Acceptance criteria - [ ] Written proposal (markdown doc in PR) covering identity key options, tradeoffs, and a recommendation - [ ] Proposed analytics DB schema with column types and rationale - [ ] At least one worked example from the fixtures showing how the identity key behaves across days - [ ] Reviewed and approved by Brandon and/or Matt before next ticket starts ## Bounty: $250 This issue has been selected for our paid contributor program. opportunities.title: [Bounty $35000] Welford Two-Pass Statistics Optimisation
opportunities.summary: ## Proposal While optimising the equal-count Welford merge path, I identified and prototyped a broader Welford-path performance improvement based on stable two-pass statistics. The proposed work replaces the underlying statistics calculation used by the Welford paths for standalone variance and standard deviation, GroupNorm, and LayerNorm where the new algorithm is beneficial. The implementation uses shifted two-pass statistics with FP32 accumulation: ```text mean = shift + average(x - shift) variance = average((x - mean)^2) ``` Centring the input before accumulation avoids cancellation for inputs with a large common offset. Separating mean and variance accumulation also removes the per-sample division and recurrence costs of online Welford. ## Scope - Implement shifted two-pass statistics with FP32 accumulation for: - Standalone FP32 `var` and `std`. - GroupNorm. - LayerNorm, including relevant interleaved and sharded paths. - Evaluate BF16 `var` and `std`, enabling two-pass statistics where they are faster without compromising numerical behaviour. - Add data-reuse and eligible L1-replay optimisations so the second pass can reuse resident input data instead of rereading it from DR

opportunities.title: parse_duration drops the days (d) unit
opportunities.summary: ## Bug `parse_duration` silently drops the **days** (`d`) unit. The README lists `d` as a supported unit, but the parser ignores it and returns a wrong (too-small) result instead of raising or counting it. ### Reproduction ```python from duration_utils import parse_duration parse_duration("1d") # -> 0 (expected 86400) parse_duration("2d4h") # -> 14400 (expected 187200) ``` ### Expected `d` should be counted as 86400 seconds, so `parse_duration("1d") == 86400` and `parse_duration("2d4h") == 187200`. ### Notes The `d` character is already accepted by the token regex, so malformed-input detection still passes — the value is just never added. A fix should add the `d` unit and cover it with tests. /bounty $50
